title: G3: bounded tool outputs with an expansion path — tests-green prints one line on pass and keeps the log on fail, review and spec-review prompts get a summary-first bounded diff, recall shows provenance and freshness
spec:
Depends on G2 (T-0266, spawn.packet). Scout T-0262: review.md inserts {{diff}} raw with no size guard and spec-review.md inserts {{code}} the same way (spawn.render about line 70); tests-green.sh prints nothing on pass and up to 40 filtered lines on fail then deletes its log; recall.py prints hits with a date but no provenance column or age.
Change:
1. .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh: on pass print exactly one stderr line 'tests-green: OK <N tests> <HEAD sha 7> <seconds>s' (N parsed from the runner output, '-' when unknown); on fail keep the failures-only block (at most 40 lines) and keep the full log at .orchestrator/runs/tests/<task-or-dir>-<ts>.log, printing its path as the last line; TESTS_GREEN_DRY behaviour unchanged.
2. spawn.bounded_diff(diff_text, cap_chars=12000, expand_hint) returns the diffstat summary first, then hunks up to the cap, then one line '<N> more lines; expand with: <expand_hint>'; spawn.bounded_text(text, cap_chars, expand_hint) for other blobs. Review and spec-review rendering pass {{diff}} and {{code}} through these with the hint naming the git command in the worktree. Caps configurable via pool.toml [limits] review_diff_chars (default 12000) and spec_review_code_chars (default 8000).
3. .claude/skills/memory/scripts/recall.py: every hit line carries provenance (mem, bus, graph) and an age in days ('3d'); output capped at [limits].recall_hits (default 30) with a final line naming how many more hits exist and the command to see them.
4. README Pipeline: a 'Bounded outputs' paragraph listing the bounds and how to expand each (git diff command, log path, recall flags); mention bus_events(since) as the delta path for bus state.
Tests: tests/test_spawn.py::test_bounded_diff_summary_first, ::test_bounded_diff_expansion_hint, ::test_review_prompt_diff_is_bounded; tests/test_tests_green.py (new): run the hook against a scratch repo with a passing unittest and a failing one, assert the OK line shape and the log path line.
acceptance: tests/test_tests_green.py passes for both the pass and the fail shape
recall.py output shows provenance and age per hit and caps at [limits].recall_hits
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

Note: the bound is applied in spawn's render path rather than by editing the two prompt templates. Posted by hand.
